step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts an image processing and model training pipeline. The image ingestion flow starts from an external user uploading images to API Gateway, routed through ALB, processed via ECS, queued in SQS, and consumed by EC2 Processing instances. The model training pipeline uses S3 for data and model weight storage with SageMaker for training, which triggers Lambda to synchronize model weights to the Processing nodes.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores training data and model weights.

nodes.name: SageMaker

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Synchronizes updated weights to processing nodes.

edges.notes: User uploads images to API Gateway.
API Gateway forwards requests to ALB.
ALB routes requests to ECS cluster.
ECS pushes image tasks to SQS queues.
Processing nodes pull tasks from SQS.
SageMaker reads training data from S3.
SageMaker saves trained weights to S3.
SageMaker triggers Lambda after training completes.
Lambda synchronizes model weights to processing nodes.
